_about: Our Wonder World: A Library of Knowledge in Ten Volumes (Chicago and Boston: Geo. L. Shuman & Co., 1914), a children's library of geography, invention, nature, exploration, stories, sports, handicraft, history, a mother's home book and a quiz book. All ten volumes, one uniform 1914 scanned run at the Internet Archive, raw OCR; much of each volume is pictures and captions, which OCR keeps only as text. Added 2026-10-23 at Adam's ask for old children's sets (the fact sets, listed last).
